agents_marketplace.charts_unavailable_body: Team popularity statistics are not available right now. You can explore recently updated Agents or browse the directory.
agents_marketplace.charts_insufficient_title: Not enough data for a chart yet
agents_marketplace.charts_insufficient_body: A chart appears when enough real member use meets the privacy requirements. You can explore recent updates in the meantime.
agents_marketplace.charts_stale_body: The previous statistics have expired. Try again later or explore recent updates.
agents_marketplace.charts_recent_error: Recent updates could not be loaded.
agents_marketplace.title: Hire an agent team for the work ahead
agents_marketplace.subtitle: Find specialists curated by your team and Bowhead. Understand capabilities, risk, and access before adding one to your personal roster.
agents_marketplace.create_no_space_title: Set up a Space before creating an Agent
agents_marketplace.create_no_space_body_manage: Agent drafts are saved in a Space, and you try the Agent there after creating it. You don’t have a Space yet: create one, then come back and choose Create Agent.
agents_marketplace.create_no_space_body_member: Agent drafts are saved in a Space, and you try the Agent there after creating it. You haven’t been added to a Space yet: ask a team owner or administrator to add you, then come back and choose Create Agent.
agents_marketplace.search_placeholder: Example: analyze sales data and build a presentation…
agents_marketplace.load_failed: Could not load the Agent Marketplace
agents_marketplace.detail_load_failed: This Agent cannot be loaded right now. Try again shortly.
agents_marketplace.agent_access_denied: You do not currently have permission to view this Agent.
agents_marketplace.saved_refresh_failed: Your change was saved, but the latest status could not be refreshed. Try refreshing again.
agents_marketplace.featured_subtitle: These agents are ordered by when your team last saved them and are within your current access. Hiring never expands data permissions.
agents_marketplace.filter_title: Find the right agent for this work
agents_marketplace.empty_body: Try another phrase or clear the current filters.
agents_marketplace.manage_saved_first_page: Saved. The list has returned to its first page.
agents_marketplace.hire_success_title: {name} is enabled in My Agent Team
agents_marketplace.hire_success_body: Lead may consider it when the work matches and your permissions and connections allow it; this does not force it into every conversation.
agents_marketplace.agent_not_found: This agent does not exist or is no longer visible to you
agents_marketplace.action_failed: Could not complete the action on this agent. Check its current state before trying again.
agents_marketplace.fork_intro: Create a private, independently managed agent from the current version of {name}. Later source updates never change it automatically.
agents_marketplace.fork_loading: Checking the exact version and your available tools…
agents_marketplace.fork_preview_failed: This agent cannot be copied right now. Its version, access, or copy settings may have changed.
agents_marketplace.fork_create_failed: Your copy was not created. Check the name or refresh the source version and try again.
agents_marketplace.fork_name_unavailable: That Agent name is already in use in this team. Choose a distinct name.
agents_marketplace.fork_source_changed: The source agent or its copy settings changed. Close this window and preview the current version again.
agents_marketplace.fork_gaps_body: Your Agent will still be saved, but starts paused until you select replacements in the manager.
agents_marketplace.fork_gap_tool: A Tool that is unavailable to you
agents_marketplace.fork_gap_skill: A Skill that is unavailable to you
agents_marketplace.fork_dependencies_ready_body: The private copy can start enabled after creation. Runtime permissions are still checked on every use.
agents_marketplace.fork_name_help: The display name must be unique in your team. Bowhead creates the routing handle automatically.
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_body: Control who may create a private copy from the released version, and see where this agent came from.
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_explanation_title: What happens when copying is allowed?
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_explanation_copy: Eligible people create a private, independently managed agent from the released version. Its instructions, output contract, and the Skills and Tools available to that person are copied.
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_explanation_gaps: Unavailable Skills or Tools become dependency gaps and the copy starts paused. Audience, shares, access grants, credentials, approvals, and evaluation history are not copied.
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_explanation_independent: A copy is maintained independently. Source upgrades and later changes to this setting never modify or revoke an existing copy.
agents_marketplace.fork_policy_not_allowed_body: The “Create my version” action stays hidden. Existing copies are unaffected.
agents_marketplace.fork_policy_recipients_body: People who can currently use this Agent may create a private copy.
agents_marketplace.fork_policy_team_members_body: Active team members may copy it only when the Agent is also visible and usable to them.
agents_marketplace.fork_policy_future_only: Setting changes apply only to future copies and never revoke an existing copy.
agents_marketplace.fork_policy_failed: Copy settings could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
agents_marketplace.fork_lineage_connected: The source is still available to you. Source updates are shown for comparison only and are never merged automatically.
agents_marketplace.fork_lineage_tombstone: The source is no longer accessible. Your independent Agent and its history remain intact.
agents_marketplace.fork_manager_gaps: {count} dependency gaps were recorded at creation
agents_marketplace.fork_original_agent_body: This agent was not copied from another agent. If copying is allowed, each eligible person receives a private, independently managed copy.
agents_marketplace.already_included: Included in Bowhead's working system; no separate hire needed
agents_marketplace.capabilities_explained: What it can do for you
agents_marketplace.capability_model_label: How Agents, Skills, and Tools work together
agents_marketplace.capability_model_agent_body: Understands the task, organizes the steps, and selects the capabilities needed for this work.
agents_marketplace.capability_model_skill_body: Supplies a professional method, template, or workflow without adding any data permission.
agents_marketplace.capability_model_tool_body: Queries, computes, or writes within your access; high-impact actions still require confirmation or approval.
agents_marketplace.capability_default: Supports {capability}. The server has not yet provided complete inputs, outputs, and limits; runtime still checks team permissions and connections.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_analysis: Frames business questions, compares key measures, and explains changes as actionable findings; conclusions remain limited by the available evidence.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_compute: Runs calculations and data processing in an isolated environment for statistics, transformation, and validation; network, file, and runtime limits apply.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_data_discovery: Locates datasets, metrics, and dimensions available to you; discovering data never expands your access.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_data_query: Queries enterprise data you can access for summaries, comparisons, and diagnosis; results depend on connections, metric definitions, and current permissions.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_document: Organizes confirmed content into a clear document; overwriting shared content still follows platform confirmation rules.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_knowledge_search: Searches team knowledge you can access and organizes supporting evidence; it cites only sources it can actually read.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_presentation: Turns analysis and evidence into a presentation narrative and slide content; final formats depend on available presentation rendering.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_report: Writes or improves reports from existing evidence while keeping claims, charts, and citations aligned; missing evidence is not presented as fact.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_skill: Uses approved professional methods, templates, or workflows; a Skill never grants additional tools, data, or connection access.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_spreadsheet: Creates or organizes spreadsheets, formulas, and structured results; write scope and file operations remain limited by the current task.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_team_read: Reads approved information from team systems using your access, never the creator’s or an administrator’s permissions.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_team_write: Can write to approved team systems; each concrete change may still require confirmation or approval.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_visualize: Turns data into charts designed for comparison and explanation; visuals reflect only queried or supplied data.
agents_marketplace.capability_desc_web_research: Researches public web sources with citations; inaccessible pages, freshness, and source limitations are called out in the result.
agents_marketplace.system_business_analyst_summary: Find actionable customer, channel, growth, funnel, and retention insights in business data.
agents_marketplace.system_compliance_analyst_summary: Review policies, controls, privacy obligations, and business risks with structured findings.
agents_marketplace.system_compute_summary: Query data, run calculations, create charts, and turn the evidence into a clear analysis.
agents_marketplace.system_consultant_summary: Shape complex business analysis into a structured, board-ready presentation.
agents_marketplace.system_financial_analyst_summary: Analyze financial statements, cash flow, key ratios, and period-over-period performance.
agents_marketplace.system_kb_analyst_summary: Research team documents, connect evidence across sources, and produce cited findings.
agents_marketplace.system_marketing_analyst_summary: Develop marketing insights, campaign reviews, competitor research, and visual creative briefs.
agents_marketplace.access_revoked_agent_summary: The creator or team changed its audience. Its current configuration is no longer disclosed, but you can safely remove it from your roster.
agents_marketplace.activation_active_ready: Lead may consider this agent when the work matches; actual use still depends on your current permissions, connections, and task context.
agents_marketplace.activation_active_not_ready: Your hire is saved, but a dependency is not ready. Lead will not treat this agent as runnable; check its status in management.
agents_marketplace.activation_paused_title: Still in My Agent Team, but disabled for you
agents_marketplace.activation_paused_body: Lead will not select this agent until you enable it again.
agents_marketplace.activation_included_body: No separate hire is needed. Lead may use it as a system candidate when the work matches and your permissions and connections allow it.
agents_marketplace.activation_access_changed_title: The hire record remains, but access has changed
agents_marketplace.activation_access_changed_body: Lead will not select this agent. You can review the status and safely remove it in management.
agents_marketplace.listing_semantic_not_run: Semantic safety check has not run
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_low: Read-only work, analysis, or isolated computation
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_medium: May create files or content for this turn
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_artifact_write: May create files or content for this turn
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_external_write: May change content in an external system
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_destructive: May delete, overwrite, or perform another destructive action
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_high: May perform a high-impact action that is confirmed again at runtime
agents_marketplace.risk_effect_unknown: The exact Tool impact has not been fully identified
agents_marketplace.source_former_team_default: Previously assigned as a team default
agents_marketplace.hire_to_use: Hire to make eligible for dispatch
agents_marketplace.execution_evidence_note: This status does not mean every Outcome is verified.
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_unverified_title: Definitions available; implementation evidence still under review
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_unverified_body: Each capability separates its stable definition, implementation evidence, and your current readiness. Legacy dependency inference is never treated as verified.
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_review_title: Outcome claims and dependencies need review
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_review_body: The formal link between this capability claim and its tool dependencies is missing. Configured tools may still run, but that does not verify the capability.
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_loading_body: Agent details are available while capability contracts and dependency evidence finish loading.
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_unavailable_title: Outcome evidence is not currently available
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_unavailable_body: The Agent's capability listing remains visible. Real-time access and connection checks still determine whether it can run.
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_error_title: Outcome evidence could not be refreshed
agents_marketplace.capability_evidence_error_body: Agent details are unaffected. Refresh later to see input/output contracts and dependency alignment.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_ready_body: The active definition, reviewed implementation evidence, and your current runtime checks are all ready.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_degraded_body: The capability can still deliver a partial result, but a non-critical dependency or evidence check is degraded.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_unavailable_title: Not available to you right now
agents_marketplace.capability_state_unavailable_body: The Agent, a required dependency, or your current access explicitly blocks this capability.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_shadow_body: This capability is still being reviewed, so it is not shown as verified yet.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_missing_body: This agent may have configured and runnable tools. Formal implementation evidence for this capability is still missing; check run results and release tests separately.
agents_marketplace.capability_state_unknown_body: Existing evidence is insufficient to prove this capability ready for your current context.
agents_marketplace.capability_management_missing: {count, plural, one {# required dependency needs attention} other {# required dependencies need attention}}
agents_marketplace.capability_management_unresolved: {count, plural, one {# runtime dependency will be checked at execution time} other {# runtime dependencies will be checked at execution time}}.
agents_marketplace.permission_note: Hiring an agent never gives it data, connections, or team-system access you do not already have. Every run is checked again.
agents_marketplace.manage_title: Manage agents you hire and create
agents_marketplace.manage_subtitle: Agents you've hired, created, or that were shared with you. Pausing an agent affects only you; editing a shared agent changes it for everyone who uses it.
agents_marketplace.drafts_body: Continue editing your saved AI or manual drafts.
agents_marketplace.drafts_load_failed: Drafts could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
agents_marketplace.drafts_unavailable: Drafts are temporarily unavailable, possibly during a service upgrade. Refresh later; your Agents are not affected.
agents_marketplace.role_preferences_load_failed: Role preferences are temporarily unavailable. Agent activation is unaffected.
agents_marketplace.role_preferences_save_failed: That preference was not saved. The Agent's status, access, or version may have changed; refresh and try again.
agents_marketplace.role_preferences_body: When two Agents can do the same kind of work, pick the one Lead should try first.
agents_marketplace.role_preference_stale: The former preference is no longer eligible because its hire, activation, access, or capability changed. Lead will not use it.
agents_marketplace.role_preferences_truncated: Your roster is large; this view shows the first 100 Agent entries that can be verified.
agents_marketplace.role_data_description: Find, query, and explain business data you are allowed to access.
agents_marketplace.role_compute_description: Run isolated calculations, transformations, and reproducible data processing.
agents_marketplace.role_deck_description: Shape evidence into a presentation narrative, slides, and deliverable file.
agents_marketplace.role_knowledge_description: Search team material you can access and organize traceable evidence.
agents_marketplace.role_canvas_edit_description: Restructure, revise, and improve an existing report.
agents_marketplace.role_image_description: Generate or edit image deliverables from an explicit brief.
agents_marketplace.view_hired_title: Control which agents Lead can choose for you
agents_marketplace.view_hired_body: Enable, pause, or unhire only affects your personal Agent Team. It never edits the creator's configuration or another member's use.
agents_marketplace.view_created_body: Open configuration and sharing here. Editing a team-visible agent may affect its audience; use Hired by me for personal activation.
agents_marketplace.view_shared_title: Choose from agents teammates shared with you
agents_marketplace.view_shared_body: Sharing lets you discover and hire this Agent; it does not automatically let you use it. After hiring, the current release, enabled state, and audience must still allow your use. You cannot edit the creator's configuration.
agents_marketplace.view_team_title: Manage team defaults and governance actions
agents_marketplace.view_team_body: Actions here may affect multiple members. Setting or removing a team default shows its impact first; personal use stays under Hired by me.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_blocked_agent_summary: Listing content is hidden until its owner resolves the safety findings.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_credential_or_secr: A secret or credential was found. Remove it before sharing this agent.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_pii: Personal information was found. Remove or replace it before sharing this agent.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_control_character: Unsupported invisible or bidirectional text controls were found.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_unsafe_url: An unsafe URL was found in the listing.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_content_injection: The listing contains instructions that could manipulate agent selection.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_check_failed: The listing could not be checked safely. Edit it and try again.
agents_marketplace.listing_safety_reason_unknown: This Agent is unavailable until its owner reviews the listing.
agents_marketplace.empty_hired_body: Browse the marketplace for an agent that fits the work.
agents_marketplace.empty_created_title: You have not created an agent
agents_marketplace.empty_created_body: Creation continues through the existing conversational Agent Creator.
agents_marketplace.empty_shared_title: No agents are shared with you yet
agents_marketplace.empty_shared_body: An agent appears here after its owner adds you to its audience. You can also discover team-visible agents in the marketplace.
agents_marketplace.empty_team_body: Only governance actions allowed by the server appear here.
agents_marketplace.unhire_running_blocked: A scheduled task is still running or awaiting input. Resolve that run before unhiring.
agents_marketplace.unhire_schedule_impact: {count} active scheduled tasks refer to this agent. You can pause them as part of unhiring.
agents_marketplace.unhire_no_schedule_impact: No active scheduled tasks will be affected. Historical runs remain available.
agents_marketplace.team_default_set_impact: This adds the agent for {affected} active members who have not chosen or opted out; {optedOut} opted-out members stay unchanged. Each member can still pause or unhire it.
agents_marketplace.team_default_remove_impact: Future automatic assignments stop. The {affected} existing team-default assignments remain as ordinary personal agents so work does not disappear unexpectedly.
agents_marketplace.view_archived_body: Archiving stops new work, releases active names, and retains release, hire, and audit history. Restore rechecks names, dependencies, and safety.
agents_marketplace.empty_archived_body: Agents you archive will be kept safely here.
agents_marketplace.release_load_failed: This agent's release studio cannot be opened right now.
agents_marketplace.release_cutover_required: This agent has not been brought into release management yet, so its release studio cannot open. It is not missing — an administrator needs to run the Agent release baseline import first.
agents_marketplace.legacy_editor_intro: This Agent still uses the original configuration flow. You can edit it here; after release migration, it will open in the new manager automatically.
agents_marketplace.legacy_editor_unavailable: This Agent cannot be edited right now. Check team licensing or read-only status; ask an administrator to finish the release baseline import if migration is needed.
agents_marketplace.release_management_unavailable: Release management is not available in this environment yet. Ask an administrator to finish setup before editing this Agent.
agents_marketplace.release_save_failed: The draft save could not be confirmed. Check the current version before retrying.
agents_marketplace.release_save_before_resource_action: Save your current changes before disabling, archiving, or restoring a previous version.
agents_marketplace.release_publish_failed: The release did not complete. Resolve the safety, dependency, or version issue and try again.
agents_marketplace.release_safety_failed: The safety check did not complete, so this version cannot be released.
agents_marketplace.release_archive_failed: The agent could not be archived. Refresh its status and try again.
agents_marketplace.release_restore_failed: The agent could not be restored. Its name may be taken, or a dependency or safety state may have changed.
agents_marketplace.release_rollback_failed: That release could not be restored to the draft. Refresh and try again.
agents_marketplace.release_output_schema_invalid: The output contract must be a valid JSON object.
agents_marketplace.release_dependency_stale: A Tool or Skill is unavailable or has changed revision. Remove unavailable items or select the current version before saving.
agents_marketplace.release_saved: Draft saved. Released v{version} hasn't changed.
agents_marketplace.release_submitted: Submitted for team approval. The released version keeps working.
agents_marketplace.release_published: The new version is active. This does not mean it has been listed in the marketplace.
agents_marketplace.release_prepared: The candidate is prepared; the released version is unchanged. Compare and release it under Release.
agents_marketplace.release_agent_enabled: Agent enabled. Paused schedules are not resumed automatically.
agents_marketplace.release_agent_disabled: Agent disabled. Lead will not select it for new work.
agents_marketplace.release_restored: Agent restored. Paused schedules still require individual confirmation before resuming.
agents_marketplace.release_rollback_ready: v{version} is restored to the draft. Review and release it before it takes effect.
agents_marketplace.release_archive_body: It immediately leaves the marketplace and Lead roster, active access is revoked, and referencing schedules are paused. Releases, hire preferences, and audit history remain. Restore never resumes schedules automatically. Any version still pending review or prepared for release is withdrawn; prepare it again after restoring.
agents_marketplace.release_pending_title: An immutable release is waiting for approval
agents_marketplace.release_pending_body: Reviewers approve the frozen candidate while released v{version} keeps serving. Withdraw this candidate before submitting another.
agents_marketplace.release_listing_body: This is what teammates use first to decide whether to hire the agent. Do not put instructions, credentials, or personal information here.
agents_marketplace.release_listing_body_private: Only you can see this introduction for now. Review it for others if you later share or list this agent.
agents_marketplace.release_display_name_required: Enter a display name before saving.
agents_marketplace.release_instructions_body: Say what it's responsible for, what counts as done, and what it must not do.
agents_marketplace.release_model_policy_locked: Fixed by team model policy and checked again on release.
agents_marketplace.release_capability_protocol_block_help: When on, this agent also receives Bowhead's usage guidance for the tools it can use, such as the rules for querying business data. The change takes effect when you publish the version.
agents_marketplace.release_capabilities_body: Skills provide methods; Tools query, compute, or write. Selecting a Skill never grants data or connection access. Runtime still uses the operator's actual permissions.
agents_marketplace.release_skill_scope_body: This custom Agent uses the Skills you add here, including those supplied by selected Plugins. Skills available in your ordinary conversations are not added automatically. Save and apply or publish the Agent version for changes to take effect. A Skill with scripts also lets the Agent run them in the sandbox; Skills never grant access to data or connections.
agents_marketplace.release_primary_body: Lead (the main agent) hands this kind of work to it. Only verified responsibilities can be chosen.
agents_marketplace.release_primary_none_body: It works fine without one; it follows the instructions above and the resources it can use.
agents_marketplace.release_primary_catalog_pending: The platform is verifying responsibilities one by one. You can keep configuring Tools and Skills; unverified capabilities are never presented as ready.
agents_marketplace.release_primary_clear_to_save: This exact version is no longer in the catalog. Select “No primary responsibility yet” before saving.
agents_marketplace.release_capability_required: Select at least one Tool or Skill so this agent has an executable capability.
agents_marketplace.release_remove_to_publish: Unavailable in the current catalog; deselect it before release
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_body: Choose the read-only methods users may explicitly add to a single task. Adding a method here does not make the Agent use it on every task or grant script execution, tools or connections. Save and apply or publish the Agent version for changes to take effect.
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_unsupported: This configuration version cannot be edited here. It is preserved with other changes unless you explicitly clear it.
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_enabled: Allow users to add methods to individual tasks
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_private: Personal methods can only be configured for Agents set to “Only me”. Remove them or change who can use this Agent to “Only me”.
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_choose_first: Add at least one method before enabling temporary use.
agents_marketplace.optional_skills_load_failed: The method catalog is unavailable. Your selections are preserved.
agents_marketplace.release_skills_body: A Skill is a method, template, or workflow. It may declare required Tools, but effective capability still depends on its exact revision and current permissions.
agents_marketplace.release_skill_fallback: A professional work method; detailed guidance has not been provided.
agents_marketplace.release_private_only: Only for Agents set to “Only me”
agents_marketplace.release_skill_audience_reason: This Agent is set to “{audience}”. This Skill can only be added to an Agent set to “Only me”. Change who can use the Agent, or choose a team Skill available to everyone who can use it.
agents_marketplace.release_personal_skill_private_only: Personal Skills can only be added to Agents set to “Only me”. Remove the personal Skills or change who can use this Agent to “Only me”.
agents_marketplace.release_skill_dependency_unavailable: A required Skill is unavailable, so this Skill cannot be added yet.
agents_marketplace.release_skill_scripts_disabled: This deployment hasn’t enabled Skill scripts; the Agent can read this Skill but not run its scripts.
agents_marketplace.release_error_dependency_blocked: A Skill or Tool can’t be used by this Agent. Remove or replace it under What it can use, then save again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_pending_reapproval: Edited and waiting for a team admin to re-approve it. Ask a team admin to review the new version, or remove this Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_not_approved: Not approved yet. Ask a team admin to approve it, or remove this Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_disabled: Turned off for the team. Ask a team admin to turn it back on, or remove this Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_bundle_unavailable: Its files can’t be read. Re-upload the Skill, or remove it.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_builtin_plugin_skill_revi: The Plugin’s method does not match this application version. Ask an administrator to update the application, or remove the Plugin.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_builtin_plugin_skill_conf: This Plugin and a separately selected Skill require different versions. Remove one selection, then save again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_risk_report_invalid: Its safety check record is damaged. Re-upload the Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_risk_report_missing: It has no safety check record yet. Re-upload the Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_identity_mismatch: This name now belongs to a different Skill. Remove it and add the Skill again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_revision_changed: It changed after it was added. Remove it and add it again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_reference_audience_: It isn’t available to everyone who can use this Agent. Change who can use the Agent, or choose a team Skill.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_grant_malformed: Its saved setting is invalid. Remove it and add it again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_grant_duplicate: It was added more than once. Remove the extra copy.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_runtime_name_confli: Another selected Skill has the same name. Keep only one of them.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_import_pending: It is still being imported. Try again after the import finishes.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_not_invokable: Its scripts can’t be run. Remove it and add it again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_approval_hash_missi: Its approval record is incomplete. Ask a team admin to approve it again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_static_risk_signal: Its instructions mention commands that need review. A team admin will review this release.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_skill_vendored_dependency: It bundles its own packages, which a team admin needs to review.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_precise_skill_scope_requi: It needs an exact grant on its Skill. Add the Skill it uses, or remove this Tool.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_legacy_skill_scope_not_pu: It was added in an older format. Remove it and add it again.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_tool_unavailable: It isn’t available right now. Remove it, or ask a team admin to turn it back on.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_tool_risk_metadata_unknow: Its risk information is missing. Ask a team admin to check its connection, or remove it.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_tool_revision_unavailable: Its current version can’t be confirmed. Ask a team admin to check its connection, or remove it.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_tool_reference_duplicate: It was added more than once. Remove the extra copy.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_generic_skill: This Agent can’t use it right now. Remove it, or check its status in the Skill catalog.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_generic_tool: This Agent can’t use it right now. Remove it, or check its status in Tools.
agents_marketplace.blocked_reason_generic_definition: The saved configuration needs attention. Refresh the page and save again.
agents_marketplace.release_audience_title: Who can discover and hire it
agents_marketplace.release_audience_body: Audience controls who can see and use the released version. It never transfers the Owner's permissions. Expanding the audience may require administrator approval.
agents_marketplace.release_audience_personal_tools_body: You can still use these tools when you run this Agent. Other members won't receive them and can use only other tools they have permission to use.
agents_marketplace.release_audience_private_body: Only you can use it. A safe version releases immediately without administrator approval.
agents_marketplace.release_audience_custom_body: Only selected people or groups receive access. Some changes are routed to administrator review.
agents_marketplace.release_audience_teamwide_body: Every active teammate can discover it. Every behavioral update goes through administrator approval.
agents_marketplace.release_find_people_placeholder: Search by name, email, or group…
agents_marketplace.release_directory_failed: The team directory could not be loaded. Try the search again.
agents_marketplace.release_custom_required: Select at least one person or group for a custom audience.
agents_marketplace.release_selected_principal: Already in this audience; clear the checkbox to remove
agents_marketplace.release_output_contract_body: An optional JSON Schema can constrain the agent's return shape. It is not a display template, and an invalid contract blocks release.
agents_marketplace.release_reason_semantic_scanner_unavaila: Semantic review is unavailable; a shared release will receive administrator review
agents_marketplace.release_reason_sensitive_data: The content may contain credentials or personal information
agents_marketplace.release_reason_unsafe_instructions: The Agent instructions may be unsafe or malformed
agents_marketplace.release_reason_external_write: A Tool can change an external system
agents_marketplace.release_reason_destructive: A Tool can delete or overwrite data
agents_marketplace.release_reason_artifact_write: A Skill can create or modify artifacts
agents_marketplace.release_reason_skill_code_risk: A Skill contains code or dependencies that need review
agents_marketplace.release_reason_external_data: A team connection accesses an external data source
agents_marketplace.release_reason_automated_execution: The Agent can run without an interactive user
agents_marketplace.release_reason_tool_dependency: A Tool is unavailable or its risk metadata changed
agents_marketplace.release_reason_skill_dependency: A Skill is unavailable, changed, or outside the target audience
agents_marketplace.release_reason_dependency_definition: The capability definition or dependency evidence needs attention
agents_marketplace.release_reason_primary_capability: The selected primary responsibility has not passed implementation and evaluation verification
agents_marketplace.release_reason_behavior_compile: The responsibility cannot form a verified execution plan with the current Tools, Skills, or output contract
agents_marketplace.release_reason_requires_attention: A policy check needs attention before release
agents_marketplace.release_note_placeholder: Tell users what changed without including credentials or personal information
agents_marketplace.release_publish_private_note: A private version is released as soon as it passes safety checks; no administrator approval is needed.
agents_marketplace.release_publish_custom_note: A normal-risk custom share can release directly. The server escalates high-risk changes for administrator approval.
agents_marketplace.release_publish_team_note: This release needs administrator approval. The released version keeps working during review.
agents_marketplace.release_archived_edit_note: Archived Agents are history-only. Restore rechecks names, dependencies, audience, and safety before editing is available again.
agents_marketplace.release_history_body: Each released version keeps its configuration and evidence. Restoring one puts it in the draft; history isn't rewritten.
agents_marketplace.release_inbox_body: You review a frozen candidate and server-derived risk diff, never an Owner's unsubmitted draft.
agents_marketplace.release_inbox_failed: The approval queue cannot be loaded right now.
agents_marketplace.release_inbox_empty_body: New team releases and high-risk shares appear here after submission.
agents_marketplace.release_review_load_failed: This release candidate cannot be read. It may have been handled or you may no longer be a reviewer.
agents_marketplace.release_review_action_failed: The approval state changed or revalidation failed. Return to the queue and refresh.
agents_marketplace.release_error_eval_required: This revision has no passing platform contract evaluation yet, so it cannot be approved. Only the agent's owner can run one — ask them to run the suite in the agent's evaluation panel, then come back to approve.
agents_marketplace.release_error_eval_critical_failure: The platform contract evaluation hit a critical failure on this revision, so it cannot be approved. Ask the agent's owner to review the results, fix the issue, and resubmit.
agents_marketplace.release_error_eval_suite_missing: This agent has no platform contract evaluation suite yet. Ask the owner to open the evaluation panel on the agent's management page — the suite installs itself, and one passing run unblocks approval.
agents_marketplace.release_error_no_reviewer: Releasing to other people needs a team admin to approve it, and this team has no one who can. Assign a team admin first, or release it as private to yourself.
agents_marketplace.release_review_complete_body: The decision is recorded. If released, affected users will receive an update through the reliable notification path.
agents_marketplace.release_diff_skill_set_changed: Skill set or exact revision changed
agents_marketplace.release_reason_optional_skill: An optional Skill source, revision, or read-only entry is unavailable. Review the allowed selections.
agents_marketplace.release_error_extension_preservation: This editor did not retain the Agent's optional Skill policy. Refresh before editing again.
agents_marketplace.release_error_skill_dependency_missing: A selected Skill is missing a required dependency. Add it again so the dependency can be included before saving.
agents_marketplace.release_error_extension_private: Personal Skills require a private Agent. Remove personal Skills or change the audience.
agents_marketplace.release_error_extension_invalid: The optional Skill policy is invalid. Check sources, specific Skills, and the selection limit.
agents_marketplace.release_error_extension_unavailable: This revision's optional Skill policy is unavailable. Ask the Agent owner to validate and publish it again.
agents_marketplace.release_diff_primary_capability_changed: The primary responsibility promised to users changed
agents_marketplace.release_diff_capability_protocol_block_c: Built-in tool guidance was turned on or off
agents_marketplace.release_diff_audience_expanded: This candidate expands who can discover or use the agent
agents_marketplace.release_diff_audience_changed: The target audience changed without expanding access
agents_marketplace.release_diff_none: The server found no user-visible behavioral difference.
agents_marketplace.release_review_behavior_body: Review the submitted responsibilities, tools and runtime limits. Private instructions, credentials and unsubmitted drafts are not shown.
agents_marketplace.release_review_audience_eyebrow: Who can use it after release
agents_marketplace.release_review_audience_boundary: A release never lets the agent use the Owner's permissions. Each run is authorized again against the actual user, team connections, and current policy.
agents_marketplace.release_review_safety_boundary: Approval makes this version available to the audience shown. Runs still check each user’s permissions and require applicable operation confirmations.
agents_marketplace.release_review_risk_no_details: No further risk details were provided. Consider the check results and intended audience.
agents_marketplace.release_reject_body: Choose the main reason so the owner knows what needs attention. This request will close; the owner can make changes and submit again. The published version is unaffected.
agents_marketplace.release_reject_risk: Risk is not justified by the value
agents_marketplace.release_reject_evidence: Safety or quality evidence is insufficient
agents_marketplace.release_review_runtime_note: Your review permissions, version content and check results are checked again when you submit. If conditions have changed, the page explains what needs attention.
agents_marketplace.localization_title: Help every teammate understand this agent
agents_marketplace.localization_body: Translate only the public name and introduction. Instructions, Tool IDs, permissions, and risk facts stay unchanged.
agents_marketplace.localization_source_locked: The source language is locked once translations exist. Resolve existing translations before changing it.
agents_marketplace.localization_ai_draft_note: AI drafted this text. Review it before confirming.
agents_marketplace.localization_save_parent_first: Save the agent draft first so the translation uses the latest source text.
agents_marketplace.localization_release_note: Confirmation does not change the released listing. It joins the next release and follows the same safety and approval path.
agents_marketplace.localization_ai_ready: AI draft ready for your review.
agents_marketplace.localization_confirmed: Translation confirmed for the next release.
agents_marketplace.localization_suggest_failed: AI translation is unavailable. You can still translate manually.
agents_marketplace.localization_save_failed: The translation draft could not be saved.
agents_marketplace.localization_confirm_failed: The translation could not be confirmed. Refresh and review the latest source.
agents_marketplace.localization_refresh_required: The source or translation changed in another window. This page is refreshed; review it before saving again.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_title: Make this agent easy to find
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_body: Choose a few stable business and work categories, then add the language your team actually uses.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_suggestion_applied: The suggestion is ready in the form. Review it before saving.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_ai_ready: AI suggestions applied for your review.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_refresh_required: This draft changed in another window. The latest version is loaded; review it before saving.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_suggest_failed: AI classification is unavailable. You can still choose categories manually.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_saved: Classification saved to the next version.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_suggestion_no_reason: Review the proposed categories before applying them.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_domains_body: Pick up to three areas where this agent is useful.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_jobs_body: Pick up to five jobs people can expect it to help with.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_team_tags_body: Choose up to 12 terms from your team's vocabulary for products, workflows, regions, or other useful groupings.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_no_team_tags: No team tags yet. Add one below or ask an administrator to prepare the shared vocabulary.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_new_tag_placeholder: Add a team tag, e.g. APAC…
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_truth_title: Classification helps discovery; it does not define access or safety.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_truth_body: Tools, skills, data connections, permissions, output types, and risk remain derived and enforced by Bowhead.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_save_parent_first: Save the agent draft first so classification uses its latest introduction and instructions.
agents_marketplace.taxonomy_release_note: This changes the draft only. It appears in the marketplace with the next approved release.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_load_failed: Team tags could not be loaded.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_create_failed: The team tag could not be created.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_change_failed: The team tag could not be changed.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_merged: Tag merged. Existing agent references now resolve to the selected tag.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_body: Create the vocabulary Owners can use. Deactivated tags stop new selection; merging keeps old agent references working as aliases.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_alias_target_locked: Other tags already point here. To keep old references working, this tag cannot be deactivated or merged again.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_merge_confirm: Existing references will follow {target}. The old tag can't be restored after merging.
agents_marketplace.team_tags_empty: No team tags yet. Create the first one to help Owners classify their agents.
agents_marketplace.eval_title: Prove this agent works before people rely on it
agents_marketplace.eval_body: Tests run without real side effects: on this change while it's being tested, otherwise on the released version. Results are bound to that version and never reuse an older agent's score.
agents_marketplace.eval_refresh_failed: The latest evaluation status could not be refreshed.
agents_marketplace.eval_platform_suite_body: Basic checks Bowhead adds to every Agent: no made-up facts, no overreach, no overspending. Nothing to maintain.
agents_marketplace.eval_owner_suite_body: Your own realistic examples test whether the agent performs its intended job.
agents_marketplace.eval_inspect_failure: See why it did not pass
agents_marketplace.eval_inspection_failed: The result could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
agents_marketplace.eval_infrastructure_failure: {count} case attempts stopped because the evaluation environment failed. This result does not measure the Agent's quality. Retry later or contact an administrator if it continues.
agents_marketplace.eval_time_limit_failure: {count, plural, one {# case run was} other {# case runs were}} stopped at the time limit; nothing is broken, but this result says nothing about the Agent's quality. Run it again, and if runs keep timing out, split the cases into smaller tasks.
agents_marketplace.eval_required_tool_not_run: {count, plural, one {# case run needs} other {# case runs need}} a Tool that can't run during evaluation: the Agent called it but nothing ran, so these results don't count as passes. Such cases can't judge quality yet.
agents_marketplace.eval_tool_not_run: {count, plural, one {# case run used} other {# case runs used}} a Tool that can't run in evaluation yet (such as querying data). Those cases can't be tested and count as neither passed nor failed.
agents_marketplace.eval_failed_cases: {count, plural, one {# case attempt did} other {# case attempts did}} not pass. Review their tasks and expected results before rerunning.
agents_marketplace.eval_incomplete_result: This evaluation has no complete result. Retry later, or contact an administrator if it continues.
agents_marketplace.eval_running: Evaluation is running in the background. You can safely leave this page.
agents_marketplace.eval_cancel_failed: The evaluation could not be cancelled.
agents_marketplace.eval_gate_candidate_body: The fixed contract must finish without a critical failure on this exact change before an administrator can approve it. Other quality failures stay visible for review.
agents_marketplace.eval_gate_candidate_body_waiting: The fixed contract must finish without a critical failure on this exact candidate before an administrator can approve it. Only the agent's owner can run it — ask them to run the suite in the agent's evaluation panel. Other quality failures stay visible for review.
agents_marketplace.eval_gate_live_body: Nothing is in review. Tests run against the released version.
agents_marketplace.eval_auto_regression_body: After definition, dependency, or team model changes, Bowhead reruns suites that have a manual baseline.
agents_marketplace.eval_policy_failed: Automatic regression settings could not be updated.
agents_marketplace.eval_builder_title: Teach Bowhead what good looks like
agents_marketplace.eval_builder_body: Write a few representative requests, or ask AI for editable suggestions. Suggested cases are never saved automatically.
agents_marketplace.eval_goal: What should this agent be good at?
agents_marketplace.eval_goal_placeholder: For example: create concise weekly sales summaries for leadership
agents_marketplace.eval_suggest_failed: AI suggestions are unavailable. You can still write cases manually.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_body: Pick questions you asked this Agent, or that members shared with you from their own conversations. Each becomes a case with the question as its task, and Coach suggests what a good answer must include.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_empty: No conversations yet. Ask this Agent a question in chat, or ask members who use it to share a turn with you from the answer's ⋯ menu.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_drafted: Drafted {count, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}} from conversations. Review them, then save the suite.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_unavailable: One of the selected conversations is no longer available. Open the list again and pick from what's there.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_failed: Couldn't draft cases from these conversations. Check that the Team model is set up, then try again.
agents_marketplace.eval_conversations_load_failed: Couldn't load your conversations with this Agent.
agents_marketplace.eval_old_defaults_notice: {count, plural, one {# case still uses} other {# cases still use}} the earlier default of no Tool calls. An Agent that queries data can fail them just for doing its job.
agents_marketplace.eval_old_defaults_updated: Updated. The suite has a new revision; earlier results stay as they were.
agents_marketplace.eval_old_defaults_failed: Couldn't update these cases. Reload the page and try again.
agents_marketplace.eval_save_failed: The quality suite could not be saved.
agents_marketplace.eval_points_rule: When a point isn't met: Required actions (which name a Tool) block a release; data facts and judgement criteria are for reference only.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_text_placeholder: Something a good answer does, for example: compares with the same month last year
agents_marketplace.eval_point_source_coach_task: Suggested by Coach from the question
agents_marketplace.eval_point_source_coach_live_answer: Suggested by Coach from the released version's answer
agents_marketplace.eval_point_source_coach_conversation: Suggested by Coach from a conversation
agents_marketplace.eval_point_reason_calibrating: Calibrating: checking that it tells good answers from bad ones. Informational, doesn't block release.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_reason_kind_not_validated: For reference only: grading for this kind of point is still being validated.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_reason_judge_changed: For reference only: the evaluation model changed, so this point is being checked again.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_reason_calibration_failed: Informational: calibration failed; this point didn't tell a good answer from a bad one. Reword it to calibrate it again.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_reason_judge_unavailable: For reference only: the evaluation model is unavailable right now, so this point can't be graded.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_preview_loading: Checking these points on the released version's answer…
agents_marketplace.eval_point_preview_failed: These points couldn't be checked on the released version's answer. Preview again, or confirm them as written.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_preview_not_met_no_quote: Not met · The released version's answer doesn't do this
agents_marketplace.eval_point_preview_no_value: The released version's answer doesn't state a value for this.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_preview_not_graded: Not graded: the evaluation model couldn't judge this point on the released version's answer.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_no_live_answer: There's no answer from the released version to this question yet. Run this suite on the released version to see how the points would be judged.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_mark_good_needs_save: Save the suite first; a good answer is kept with saved points.
agents_marketplace.eval_point_mark_good_failed: The good answer couldn't be saved. Try again.
agents_marketplace.release_review_eval_body: Approval uses only the fixed contract result for this candidate—not a score from a previous release.
agents_marketplace.quality_evidence_body: These are safe result summaries for the current version, not a guarantee that every future request will succeed.
agents_marketplace.quality_evidence_missing_body: The creator has not published a team-visible result for this version.
agents_marketplace.quality_evidence_boundary: Tests run in an isolated evaluation mode. They do not grant the agent extra permissions or call production side effects.
agents_marketplace.prompt_budget_required: Required: an agent with no instructions runs with no role, boundaries or output contract
agents_marketplace.prompt_budget_over: Long: aim for ≤{rec} tokens — move examples and long checklists into a skill and keep only hard rules here
agents_marketplace.version_config_capability_empty: No new responsibility is ready to promise
agents_marketplace.version_config_capability_unavailable_bo: These responsibilities don't have enough implementation and evaluation evidence yet, so they can't be chosen.
agents_marketplace.version_config_capability_auto_update: Agents use the latest Tools and Skills in a selected Plugin on their next run.
agents_marketplace.version_config_resources_selected_body: This agent has {plugins} Plugins, {skills} Skills, {connections} team Tool connections, and {tools} built-in Tools, counting what its Plugins bring. A connection's concrete Tools are pinned when you save.
agents_marketplace.version_config_resources_from_plugins: Everything this agent can use comes from the Plugins selected above: {names}. Clear a Plugin above to remove what it brings.
agents_marketplace.version_config_resources_none_body: Add at least one Skill or Tool before this agent can perform work.
agents_marketplace.version_config_resources_add_body: One search finds Plugins, Tools and Skills. Add a team Tool connection once; Bowhead Tools are added as individual actions.
agents_marketplace.version_config_connection_capabilities: Includes {count} callable capabilities; the current scope is pinned when saved
agents_marketplace.version_config_unavailable_connections: Legacy team Tool connections needing attention
agents_marketplace.version_config_market_save_first_body: Translated descriptions and categories attach to the draft. Save the core configuration before editing them.
agents_marketplace.version_config_market_not_listing: Edit descriptions, categories, and advanced settings here. Saving or activating a version is not a separate marketplace listing action; the current marketplace still shows team-visible versions under existing access rules.
agents_marketplace.version_config_unsaved: Not saved yet. Saving puts it in the draft; v{version} doesn't change.
agents_marketplace.version_config_no_draft: You're viewing released v{version}. Saving creates a draft; people keep using v{version} until you release.
agents_marketplace.version_config_saved: Saved to the draft. Test this change on Evaluate or Release.
agents_marketplace.version_release_save_first: Configuration has unsaved changes. Return to Configuration and save before preparing or releasing a candidate.
agents_marketplace.version_release_no_draft: There is no draft to release yet. Save a draft from Configuration before preparing a candidate.
agents_marketplace.version_check_unavailable: Version check isn't available for this agent.
agents_marketplace.version_policy_changed: The evaluation policy was updated with the latest saved test cases after this page loaded. The page now uses the current policy; choose Test this change again.
agents_marketplace.version_plan_behind_refused: Test cases were saved after this page loaded, so these results don’t include them. The page now shows the latest state; run the comparison again to include them.
agents_marketplace.version_plan_refresh_space_denied: You can no longer run checks in the Space this test uses. Ask to be added back to that Space, or switch to a Space you can use and test again.
agents_marketplace.version_fixture_expired: The test case “{case}” in “{suite}” expired on {date}, so the test plan can’t include it. On the Evaluate tab, remove it from that suite (add it again as a new case if you still need it), save, then try again.
agents_marketplace.version_fixture_expired_unknown_suite: The test case “{case}” expired on {date}, so the test plan can’t include it. On the Evaluate tab, remove it from its suite (add it again as a new case if you still need it), save, then try again.
agents_marketplace.version_fixture_expired_platform: The platform check case “{case}” expired on {date}. It isn’t part of your Agent’s settings; ask your administrator to update the platform checks, then try again.
agents_marketplace.version_fixture_expired_unnamed: A test case has expired, so the test plan can’t include it. On the Evaluate tab, remove expired cases from your suites, save, then try again.
agents_marketplace.version_platform_contract_upgraded: The Safe execution contract was updated after this check ran. Run the release check again; the Agent doesn't need changes.
agents_marketplace.version_agent_archived: This agent is archived, so this action isn't available.
agents_marketplace.version_reason_agent_safety_blocked: The safety check did not pass
agents_marketplace.version_reason_attempt_infrastructure_in: Some case runs stopped because of a platform error
agents_marketplace.version_reason_baseline_result_missing: Results for the released version are missing
agents_marketplace.version_reason_candidate_result_missing: Results for this change are missing
agents_marketplace.version_reason_comparison_cost_budget_ex: The evaluation went over its usage limit
agents_marketplace.version_reason_comparison_duration_budge: The evaluation went over its time limit
agents_marketplace.version_reason_attempt_time_limit_exceed: Some evaluation runs went over the time limit for one run and have no result
agents_marketplace.version_reason_required_tool_not_run_in_: Some cases require a Tool that can't run during evaluation, so they have no result
agents_marketplace.version_reason_tool_not_run_in_eval: Some cases use a Tool that can't run in evaluation yet, so they can't be tested
agents_marketplace.version_test_used_tool_not_run_body: Some cases need a Tool that can't run in evaluation yet (such as querying data), so they can't be tested, and testing again won't change that. They don't count as failed, and they aren't counted as better, unchanged or worse.
agents_marketplace.version_reason_compatibility_unknown: Compatibility with the released version couldn't be confirmed
agents_marketplace.version_reason_minimum_delta_not_met: The improvement is smaller than required
agents_marketplace.version_reason_owner_quality_skipped: Your own evaluation suites weren't run
agents_marketplace.version_reason_point_regression: A point the model graded is no longer met
agents_marketplace.version_reason_point_unmet: A point the model graded wasn't met
agents_marketplace.version_reason_provider_identity_attribu: The two versions' models only partly match, so results are indicative
agents_marketplace.version_reason_provider_identity_incompa: The two versions used different models, so results cannot be compared directly
agents_marketplace.version_reason_provider_identity_unknown: The model used for evaluation could not be confirmed
agents_marketplace.version_reason_evaluation_plan_changed: The evaluation plan changed; validate again
agents_marketplace.version_reason_base_release_changed: The released version changed; test again
agents_marketplace.version_override_saved: The risk decision is recorded with this test's evidence.
agents_marketplace.version_workspace_required: Select a space first so the evaluation uses an explicit data scope.
agents_marketplace.version_review_evidence_body: These results apply to the submitted version. Consider the changes and intended audience before approving.
agents_marketplace.version_review_actor_overlap: The reviewer is also this Agent’s Owner. The decision records this actor overlap.
agents_marketplace.version_proposals_body: Changes suggested for this Agent, for example from members' feedback or an external pipeline. Review each one before merging it into the draft; merging changes only the draft, and the released version stays as it is.
agents_marketplace.version_member_feedback_title: {count, plural, one {# thumbs-down to review} other {# thumbs-downs to review}}
agents_marketplace.version_member_feedback_improve: Use this to improve the Agent
agents_marketplace.version_member_feedback_failed: Couldn't update this item. The member may have stopped sharing it; the list has been refreshed.
agents_marketplace.version_suggested_cases_note: Review the questions and what they check, then add this set to your tests. You can adjust individual items below. Adding tests does not run them.
agents_marketplace.version_suggested_case_suite_required: Create one of your own suites in Evaluation suites first
agents_marketplace.version_suggested_cases_accepted: Selected test changes were saved as a new suite version.
agents_marketplace.version_proposal_no_base: This Agent has no released version or saved draft to merge into yet. Save the configuration first, then merge.
agents_marketplace.version_proposal_select_one: Select at least one change to merge.
agents_marketplace.version_proposal_applied: Merged {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} into the draft. The released version is unchanged.
agents_marketplace.reason_agent_retired_full: This agent has been turned off or archived, or its owner has left the team.
agents_marketplace.reason_blocked_by_admin_full: An administrator has restricted your use of this agent.
agents_marketplace.reason_blocked_by_admin_note: Contact an administrator if you have questions
agents_marketplace.reason_agent_needs_owner_fix_full: This Agent cannot be used until an issue with its released version or safety is resolved. Ask its owner or a team administrator to check its status.
agents_marketplace.reason_agent_needs_owner_fix_note: Ask {owner} or a team administrator to check it
agents_marketplace.reason_not_shared_with_you_full: This agent hasn't been shared with you.
agents_marketplace.reason_not_in_space_full: You're not a member of the current space.
agents_marketplace.reason_dependency_blocked_for_you_full: It needs a resource that an administrator has restricted for you.
agents_marketplace.reason_dependency_blocked_for_you_note: Contact an administrator if you have questions
agents_marketplace.reason_dependency_broken_full: A resource it needs isn't available right now.
agents_marketplace.reason_dependency_broken_note: Its owner and an administrator need to fix it
agents_marketplace.reason_missing_access_to_dependency_full: It needs a resource you don't have access to yet.
agents_marketplace.reason_temporarily_unavailable_full: We can't confirm whether it can be used right now. Try again in a moment.
agents_marketplace.reason_agent_retired_note_manager: You can restore it from its management page
agents_marketplace.reason_agent_needs_owner_fix_note_manage: You can fix this in its configuration
agents_marketplace.limited_short: {n, plural, =0 {{x} unavailable} other {{x} and # more unavailable}}
agents_marketplace.limited_full: {n, plural, =0 {{x}, which it uses, isn't available right now.} one {{x} and 1 more it uses aren't available right now.} other {{x} and # more it uses aren't available right now.}} Related abilities won't work; everything else works as usual.
agents_marketplace.limited_full_unnamed: A resource it uses isn't available right now. Related abilities won't work; everything else works as usual.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_subtitle: Review your Agent directory and the items that need attention.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_scope: Current team · Your accessible management entries. Private Agents from other authors and built-in Agents are excluded.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_reviews_error: The approval count could not be read. Open the review queue or refresh.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_forbidden_body: Your team management access has changed. Return to Agents to continue.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_error: The directory overview could not be read
agents_marketplace.dashboard_error_body: Refresh to try again. The approval queue can still be opened independently.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_incomplete: A complete directory read could not be obtained. Refresh, or open team management for the current entries.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_omitted: Some management entries could not be returned. Counts and charts cover only the entries read successfully.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_empty_body: This team view has no accessible Agent entries or remaining default settings.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_listing_note: Listing checks cover listing content only. They do not measure Agent quality or runtime readiness.
agents_marketplace.dashboard_domains_note: An Agent can cover several domains, so these counts may exceed the number of entries.

llm.title: Team model configuration
llm.subtitle: Configure team-level providers, agent routing, and KB models. API keys are stored only in encrypted backend config; chat users can choose only team-allowed models.

providers.title: Providers
providers.desc: Configure model services Bowhead can call. Model IDs must match the exact strings accepted by the provider API.
providers.empty: No team providers yet. Add an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible provider to start.

fields.provider_id_hint: Stable identifier used for routing, audit, and model selection; do not rename it once referenced.
fields.adapter_type_hint: Determines request shape; current support is OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible.
fields.base_url_hint: Provider API root URL. Include any required compatible endpoint path.
fields.api_key_hint: Write-only field. After saving, only a fingerprint is shown and nothing is stored in the browser.
fields.timeout_hint: Maximum wait time for one model request.
fields.messages_path_hint: Advanced path setting for Anthropic-compatible providers; DeepSeek currently needs /messages.
fields.models_hint: One model ID per line. These appear in agent routing and the chat model picker.
fields.default_headers_hint: Advanced JSON. Sensitive headers are treated as secrets.
fields.max_output_tokens_hint: Limits this agent's output length for one request.
fields.routing_policy_hint: Advanced policy field; usually quality_first today.
fields.fallback_hint: One provider/model per line; tried in order when the primary model fails.
fields.kb_model_name_hint: Team-unique name used by active selections and audit.
fields.kb_capability_hint: The role this model serves in KB runtime.
fields.kb_provider_hint: Provider that serves this KB model.
fields.real_id_hint: Exact model string sent to the provider API.
fields.dim_hint: Required only for embedding models; dimension changes require reindex.

routing.title: Agent routing
routing.desc: Configure primary and fallback models for Bowhead agents. Unknown advanced fields are preserved and not overwritten by the form.
routing.no_providers: Configure at least one provider before selecting agent models.

lead.label: Lead
lead.desc: Understands intent, asks clarifying questions, plans steps, calls tools, and produces the main answer.

modeler.label: Modeler

narrative.label: Narrative

echo.label: Echo

judge.label: Judge
judge.desc: Used for quality evaluation, validation, guardrails, or difference checks.

analyst_default.label: Analyst default
analyst_default.desc: Default model for analysis, query, chart, and data interpretation.

analyst_compute.label: Analyst - compute
analyst_compute.desc: Analysis model biased toward SQL, computation, validation, and structured reasoning.

analyst_narrative.label: Analyst - narrative
analyst_narrative.desc: Analysis model biased toward explanation, summary, and report prose.

kb.title: KB models

integrations.detail_subtitle: Work through the four stages in order when possible. You can inspect later stages or skip for now at any time; skipping never changes the current configuration. System checks and human confirmation stay distinct.

integrations.recheck_failed: Check failed. The previous status has been preserved.

integrations.stage04_subtitle: Real message flows and launch record
integrations.boundary_no_auto_app: Bowhead does not create or publish a Feishu app.
integrations.boundary_no_auto_manual: Manual console work is never marked automatically complete.
integrations.boundary_no_admin_binding: The admin page does not generate member binding links, QR codes, or statistics.
integrations.boundary_no_metrics: Traffic, latency, and launch history are not shown without backend data.

integrations.manual_task_acceptance_description: Stage 04 · Test real message flows and record results

integrations.next_recheck_description: Stage 03 · Refresh Bowhead configuration and runtime state
integrations.master_switch_description: This is the only place to disable the Feishu integration.
integrations.master_switch_hint: Turning it off stops new messages while preserving credentials and event ingress.
integrations.disabled_preserves_config: The integration is off. Existing credentials and event ingress are preserved for the next enable.
integrations.credentials_secret_hint: Blank secret fields keep their saved values.
integrations.secret_leave_blank: Configured; leave blank to keep the saved value
integrations.secret_optional_ingress: Match the Feishu console security settings; leave blank to preserve a saved value
integrations.encrypt_key_requirement: Required for Webhook in production and must match the Feishu console; leave blank to preserve a saved value

integrations.ingress_webhook_hint: Feishu pushes events to a public callback URL; suitable for deployments with a stable public entry.
integrations.ingress_long_connection_hint: Bowhead connects to Feishu; credential changes may require restarting the runtime worker.
integrations.linkage_stopped_webhook: Stop traffic and preserve Webhook configuration
integrations.linkage_stopped_long: Stop traffic and preserve long-connection configuration
integrations.linkage_disabled_excluded: Use the master switch to stop the integration; Disabled is not an ingress option
integrations.linkage_legacy_note: Legacy Disabled records are read as stopped. If their prior ingress was already lost it cannot be recovered; Webhook is shown as the fallback and an admin must confirm it.
integrations.group_public_description: When enabled, final answers are posted as public cards visible to every group member, including people without a Bowhead account or outside the space.
integrations.group_public_confirm_description: Final answers will be posted as public cards that every group member can see, including people without a Bowhead account or outside the space. Ask a space admin to confirm the copy and data exposure first.
integrations.config_save_hint: Saving only writes this team's configuration; it does not perform Feishu console work.

integrations.manual_console_notice_description: Bowhead can provide exact URLs and checklists, but cannot know whether configuration, authorization, and publishing were completed in Feishu Open Platform.
integrations.developer_console_hint: Open the console for your Feishu or Lark environment to configure events, permissions, and publishing.
integrations.callback_urls_hint: Copy these into the event subscription and card callback fields in Feishu Open Platform.

integrations.auto_attention_description: Resolve the configuration or runtime problems below, then check again.
integrations.automatic_checks_hint: Only conditions Bowhead can reliably determine from configuration and runtime state are shown.
integrations.runtime_problems_hint: These come from the current backend runtime, without speculative traffic metrics.
integrations.auto_not_approval_title: Automatic pass is not human approval
integrations.auto_not_approval_description: Feishu console permissions, real message flows, and the launch decision still require manual acceptance in the next stage.
integrations.problem_app_id_description: Return to Connection & credentials and enter the Feishu app ID.
integrations.problem_app_secret_description: Return to Connection & credentials and enter the Feishu app secret.
integrations.problem_verification_token_description: Webhook security validation needs the same Verification Token as the Feishu console.
integrations.problem_encrypt_key_description: The current event security setup needs the same Encrypt Key as the Feishu console.
integrations.problem_bot_open_id_description: Enter the bot Open ID used by message and card flows.
integrations.problem_event_store_description: Event deduplication and state storage are unavailable. Next: the deployment owner checks Gateway event-store initialization, then rechecks here. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.problem_long_restart_description: The running connection still uses old configuration. Next: the deployment owner restarts the service, then rechecks here. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.problem_long_failed_description: Common causes are invalid credentials or unreachable networks. Next: the deployment owner inspects Gateway logs, fixes and restarts the service, then rechecks here. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.problem_long_not_running_description: No running long connection was detected, so Feishu events will not reach Bowhead. Next: the deployment owner starts the service, then rechecks here. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.problem_provider_secret_description: Feishu messages can enter, but the Agent cannot answer. Next: complete the referenced provider credentials under Team settings → Models.
integrations.problem_dev_auth_title: Authentication is not in production mode
integrations.problem_dev_auth_description: Development identity fallback may be active and is not production-ready. Next: the deployment owner sets BOWHEAD_AUTH_MODE to production and restarts. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.problem_unknown_runtime_description: Health is degraded without a specific reason. Next: the deployment owner inspects Gateway logs. This page cannot fix it.
integrations.acceptance_manual_description: This page provides a checklist and record template. It does not offer an automatic smoke test or approval button, and it does not persist human completion state.
integrations.acceptance_checklist_hint: A tester runs each item in the target tenant and records results and evidence in the launch record.

integrations.email_authentication_description: Most providers require a dedicated SMTP password or app token. Do not enter your normal sign-in password.
integrations.email_sender_description: Recipients see this address and name. Matching the From address to the SMTP login usually avoids provider rejections.
integrations.email_env_notice: This team has no SMTP override and is using the instance default. Deployment parameters are hidden to protect infrastructure details.
integrations.email_none_warning: SMTP is not configured — invites, email verification, password resets and notification emails cannot be sent. Fill in the settings below, or ask ops to set an instance default.

integrations.email_test_ok: Test email sent — check your inbox (and spam folder).
integrations.email_clear_confirm_description: This falls back to the instance default. Already-sent mail is unaffected; queued mail uses whatever configuration resolves after clearing. If the instance is also unconfigured, later mail cannot be sent.

slack.load_failed: Couldn't load the Slack configuration. Try again later.
