slack.description: Let team members start conversations in Slack direct messages or in channel threads where they @Bowhead. Credentials are used only for this team and are stored encrypted.
slack.step1_note: First, register and verify a stable HTTPS address in Team Settings → Public Access. Slack must be able to reach the OAuth, event, command, and interaction callbacks through that address. Don't use an internal address or a self-signed certificate.
slack.step2_intro_title: Create the app in your Slack workspace
slack.step2_intro_body: Keep the credentials page open when you're done. You'll copy three credentials in the next step.
slack.template_body: Under “Start with a template”, choose Starter app, then click Continue. Don't choose AI agent, From a manifest, or Blank app.
slack.confirm_title: Confirm the app and Slack workspace
slack.confirm_body: Enter an app name (for example, Bowhead), choose the Slack workspace where the bot will be installed, then click Review App and Create and Install.
slack.credentials_body: On the “Bowhead is ready!” page, expand Your app credentials and copy the Client ID, Client Secret, and Signing Secret. Then click Go To App Settings.
slack.form_body: Copy the credentials from Your app credentials on the previous page, then save. Secrets left blank keep their saved values. Reinstalling replaces the bot token.
slack.credentials_hint: App ready page → Your app credentials
slack.channel_answers_checkbox: Allow public answers in channel threads when mentioned
slack.channel_answers_hint: When this is off, Bowhead still works in direct messages. In channels, it asks people to have an admin turn this on.
slack.form_footer: After you save, the team bot's OAuth callback URL appears. Once installed, the status changes to “Installed, not enabled yet”.
slack.step4_title: Register the team bot callback and install
slack.step4_item1: In the Slack app's OAuth & Permissions, click Add New Redirect URL under Redirect URLs.
slack.step4_item2: Copy the team bot callback URL below, add it, and save.
slack.step4_item3: Click “Install to Slack” and authorize as an admin of your Slack workspace.
slack.bot_redirect_label: Team Slack bot OAuth redirect URL
slack.step4_pending: Complete the earlier steps and save the Slack app credentials first. The team bot's OAuth callback URL will appear here.
slack.events_description: In Slack's Event Subscriptions, enter the event URL and subscribe to app_mention and message.im.
slack.commands_description: In Slack's Slash Commands, create the command and enter the Request URL.
slack.interactivity_description: In Slack's Interactivity & Shortcuts, turn on interactivity and enter the Request URL.
slack.step5_pending: After the team bot is installed, the callback URLs and setup links for Events, Slash Commands, and Interactivity appear here.
slack.step6_intro: Each member completes Slack OAuth on their own. Personal tokens never become the team bot token, and team admins and other members can't view or use them.
slack.step6_item1: In the same Slack app's OAuth & Permissions, add the URL below to Redirect URLs and save.
slack.step6_item2: Scroll to Scopes and add each permission below under User Token Scopes (not Bot Token Scopes).
slack.step6_item3: After saving, reinstall the app when Slack prompts you. Then each member chooses “Connect My Slack” in My Connections and authorizes again.
slack.personal_redirect_label: Personal Slack MCP OAuth redirect URL
slack.personal_scopes_label: Personal Slack MCP user token scopes
slack.personal_scopes_note: These permissions are only for searching and reading messages, channels, files, and user profiles. They don't allow sending messages, creating channels, or writing to Canvas.
slack.step6_pending: After team Slack is enabled, your deployment administrator can make “Connect My Slack” available to members. Once it's available, come back here to set up the personal callback URL and user token scopes.

errors.network_error: The network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.err_generic: The model configuration action failed. Refresh the page and try again. If the problem continues, contact your system administrator.
errors.err_invalid_fields: Some model configuration fields are invalid. Check the form and try again.
errors.err_sign_in_again: Your sign-in session or team membership has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.err_insufficient_role: Your account cannot manage team model settings. Contact the team owner.
errors.err_readonly: The team is read-only or has a license problem, so model settings cannot be changed. Contact your system administrator.
errors.err_config_unavailable: The team model configuration could not be read. Try again later; if the problem continues, share the diagnostics with an administrator.
errors.err_gateway_blocked: A gateway or proxy blocked this request before it reached the application. This is usually a WAF rule (URLs in a model source trigger some default rules) — ask your operations team to review the gateway rules for this path; refreshing will not help.
errors.err_config_version_conflict: The model configuration was updated by another administrator while this draft was open. Refresh the page and apply your changes again.
errors.err_invalid_config: The model configuration did not pass validation. Return to the draft, fix the highlighted issues, and try again.
errors.err_reindex_required: Changing the knowledge-base vector model requires a confirmed index rebuild. Review the impact, confirm the rebuild, and apply again.
errors.err_encryption_required: Model-key encryption is not configured for this deployment, so the model configuration cannot be saved. Contact your system administrator.
errors.err_provider_not_configured: This model source no longer exists or is not present in the current configuration. Refresh the model settings and try again.
errors.err_reindex_not_found: This index-rebuild task was not found. It may have completed or been refreshed; reload the model configuration.
errors.err_reindex_failed: The knowledge-base index rebuild failed, and the previous index is still serving. Check the model source, then select the vector model again and apply.
errors.err_provider_not_testable: This model source is missing the endpoint, key, or model information required for a connection test. Complete it and try again.
errors.err_provider_type_unsupported: This model source protocol cannot be tested. Choose the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible protocol.
errors.err_provider_identity_conflict: This source identifier is already reserved by another draft or administrator. Use a different identifier, or wait for the other draft to be applied or expire.
errors.err_discovery_failed: The model catalog could not be read. Check the endpoint, key, and network, or add the model ID manually.
errors.err_verification_stale: The verification plan or apply review expired because the configuration or evidence changed. Review and confirm it again.
errors.err_review_stale: The pre-save review changed, but your draft is preserved. Select Load latest and review again; you only need to verify the connection again if you then change the model source or its capabilities.
errors.err_readiness_blocked: The current model assignment is not ready to run. Fix the blocking items or complete the required risk confirmation.
errors.err_security_policy: The model source address was blocked by the security policy. Use an allowed HTTPS endpoint.
errors.err_api_key_required: This model source does not have a saved key yet. Enter an API key to continue.
errors.validation_invalid_schema: The model configuration version is invalid. Refresh the page and edit the latest configuration.
errors.validation_blocked_url: A model source address was blocked by the security policy. Enter an allowed public address.
errors.validation_unknown_reference: The model configuration references a deleted or missing source or model. Select an available item.
errors.validation_required: The model configuration is missing a required value. Complete the highlighted field.
errors.validation_unsupported: The model configuration contains an unsupported type or capability. Choose one of the available options.
errors.validation_invalid_value: The model configuration contains an invalid value. Check the highlighted field.
errors.validation_provider_identity_required: This model source has not completed its safe precheck. Return to the source, save it again, and retry.
errors.validation_invalid_config: The model configuration did not pass validation. Review the draft settings and try again.
errors.validation_warning: One model configuration item needs attention. Review the draft before applying it.

v4.validation_ok: No blocking issues. This draft can be applied.
v4.reindex_body: The vector model changed. Applying will build a new index for {count} active file(s); the old index keeps serving until the new one is complete.
v4.reindex_confirm: I confirm the knowledge-base index rebuild after apply

v2.parameter_probe_limits: The configured output or thinking budget exceeds safe verification limits (4,096 output / 2,048 thinking tokens). Lower the draft budget if appropriate, or verify it through a separately approved provider test. This probe sends no request and does not change your policy.
v2.discovery_body: Select models offered by the service. After adding them, choose the capabilities you need and verify them.
v2.discovery_truncated: The service returned many models. Only the first 1,000 are shown; search or add the rest manually.
v2.discovery_not_supported: Anthropic-compatible sources do not expose a standard model catalog. Enter the model ID manually.
v2.runtime_key_hint: Give the connection a unique identifier. It cannot be changed after saving. Use letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
v2.capability_required_body: : Select at least one capability you need for each model, such as chat or image understanding.
v2.selection_body: Capabilities recommended for your current tasks are selected. Review the request count and cost notice, then confirm to start verification.
v2.verification_request_count: {count} request(s) will be sent to the model service
v2.verification_concurrency: Up to {count} team request(s) run concurrently
v2.verification_charge_note: Verification sends test requests to the model service and may incur charges. Tests do not include your business data or execute tools.
v2.verification_progress: Verified {verified} · Failed {failed} · Cannot verify automatically {notTestable} · Unfinished {unfinished} · In progress {pending}
v2.failure_auth: The credential was rejected. Replace the saved secret and verify again.
v2.failure_forbidden: The service denied access. Check the credential scope and deployment permissions.
v2.failure_api_version: The API Version is unsupported. Check the provider documentation and configured version.
v2.failure_deployment: The deployment or model was not found. Check its exact ID and endpoint.
v2.failure_endpoint: The request endpoint was not found. Check the root URL and selected protocol.
v2.failure_parameter: A request parameter is incompatible with this model. Review model-specific parameters.
v2.failure_request: The service rejected the request shape. Check the protocol and request template.
v2.failure_timeout: The connection timed out. Check network reachability and the service status.
v2.failure_dns: The domain name could not be resolved. Check the hostname and network DNS.
v2.failure_tls: The TLS connection failed. Check the certificate chain and HTTPS endpoint.
v2.failure_unavailable: The model service is unavailable. Retry after checking the upstream service.
v2.failure_rate_limited: The model service rate limit was reached. Wait or increase the upstream quota.
v2.failure_response: The service response could not be read. Check that the selected response format matches the service.
v2.failure_tool: The model did not return a tool call. Check that this deployment supports tools.
v2.failure_embedding: The service returned no embeddings. Check that the model supports embeddings and that the response format is correct.
v2.failure_embedding_non_finite: The service returned embeddings with invalid numbers. Check the model service.
v2.failure_model_identity: The response model differs from the declaration. Check gateway model mapping.
v2.failure_security_policy: The endpoint was blocked by the outbound network policy. Use an allowed public endpoint.
v2.failure_empty_completion: The service returned no assistant output. Check model availability and response mapping.
v2.failure_internal_probe: Verification could not be completed. Please retry. If the issue persists, contact your administrator.
v2.failure_probes_disabled: Online capability verification has not been enabled by your administrator.
v2.failure_runner_interrupted: Verification was interrupted. Retry the unfinished items.
v2.failure_generic: Verification failed. Review the details below. If you need help, share the diagnostic code with your administrator.
v2.verification_cancel_confirm: New verification requests will stop. Requests already sent may still complete and incur charges.
v2.recovered_body: Verified {verified} · Failed {failed} · Not testable {notTestable} · Unfinished {unfinished} · In progress {pending}. Refreshing will not resend terminal requests.
v2.recovered_terminal_body: Verified {verified} · Failed {failed} · Not testable {notTestable} · Unfinished {unfinished}. Hide this notice to continue configuring.
v2.risk_accept_title: Accept the risk of an untestable capability
v2.risk_accept_body: The {capability} capability of {model} is used for {role} and cannot currently be verified automatically. I understand it may not work and confirm continued use of this model.
v2.risk_accept_title_capability_failed: Accept the risk of a failed capability check
v2.risk_accept_body_capability_failed: {model} declares {capability} for {role}, and its most recent verification failed. I confirm that I understand and still want to use this configuration.
v2.risk_accept_title_capability_stale: Accept the risk of stale evidence
v2.risk_accept_body_capability_stale: {model} declares {capability} for {role}, and its verification evidence is stale for the current configuration. I confirm that I understand and still want to use this configuration.
v2.risk_accept_title_capability_unknown: Accept the risk of an unverified capability
v2.risk_accept_body_capability_unknown: {model} declares {capability} for {role}, and has no successful verification evidence yet. I confirm that I understand and still want to use this configuration.
v2.migration_accept_title: Confirm continued use of existing models
v2.migration_accept_body: These models are already in use but have not been verified using the current checks. I confirm their continued use. Changing these models or capabilities will require verification.
v2.baseline_invalidation: The affected model capabilities will need to be checked again after this change.
v2.external_status_configured: Configured; this service is not included in this verification
v2.readiness_verification_optional: The capabilities below have no valid verification results. You can acknowledge the risks and save, or return to model assignments to verify them first. After verification, review and confirm again before saving.

sources.title: Your model sources
sources.sub: Which models you've connected — address, key, capabilities, test connection.
sources.empty_body: Bowhead runs on your own models. Connect an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible source with its address and key to get started.
sources.verification_open_reason: A model check is open. Close it to edit or delete this connection.

connect.title: Connect a model service
connect.proto_hint: Other vendors (Gemini / Bedrock / Ernie) connect via a compatibility proxy — enter the proxy address as the Endpoint.
connect.proto_hint_azure: For Azure OpenAI and Azure-compatible gateways. Follow the service documentation to enter the endpoint, API Version, credentials, and Deployment.
connect.proto_hint_custom: For model services that need custom requests. Follow the service documentation to fill in request templates and choose the matching response format.
connect.name: Name
connect.base_url_hint: Enter the root of the compatible endpoint, including any vendor prefix such as /v1 or /openai. Don't append /chat/completions.
connect.custom_base_url_hint: Required when the URL template references the Endpoint; leave blank when the template contains the complete HTTPS URL.
connect.azure_endpoint_hint: Enter the root Endpoint only. Do not include /openai/deployments/.../chat/completions; configure Deployment on each model.
connect.azure_api_version_hint: Use the Azure API version supported by your enterprise gateway. Currently recommended: 2024-10-21.
connect.azure_deployment_hint: Leave blank to use the model ID as Deployment, or enter a separate deployment alias.
connect.api_surface_hint_responses: Some models require the Responses API. Verify the model capabilities again after changing the API.
connect.context_window_hint: The most an Agent can read at once.
connect.credit_rates_invalid: Enter a value from 0 to 1,000 with at most six decimal places for each multiplier.
connect.custom_deployment_hint: Set this when the URL or body uses the deployment placeholder; the model ID is used when blank.
connect.model_body_overrides_hint: Enter JSON parameters by capability, such as temperature for chat. Only fixed parameters already present in the request template can be changed. User messages are not configured here.
connect.model_body_overrides_invalid: Enter a JSON object whose keys are capabilities selected for this model and whose values are JSON objects.
connect.duplicate_model_note: Each model ID must be unique within a source. Remove the duplicate row or use a different ID.
connect.custom_http_safety_hint: Use POST requests and follow the template guidance for URLs, parameters, and response formats. Scripts are not supported here.
connect.messages_path_hint: Anthropic-compat custom endpoint (e.g. /messages for DeepSeek); leave blank for the default.
connect.catalog_hint: Add models offered by this service and select the capabilities you need.
connect.catalog_empty_body: Pick a protocol and address, then add the models you want to use.
connect.unverified_note: : These capabilities have not been verified. Verify them before using them for team tasks.
connect.protocol_hint: Image APIs differ in how they're called; the wrong one fails at runtime. DashScope (Qwen image) uses async polling, Volcano Ark (Doubao) uses sync.
connect.image_probe_confirm: The test submits a real image-generation request to the provider and may incur charges.
connect.pure_image_note: : this source only has an image model and no chat model — saving is still allowed.
connect.protocol_hint_search: Search APIs differ in how they're called; the wrong one fails at runtime. DashScope (Qwen) uses OpenAI-compatible by default; pick native generation when you need a structured source list.
connect.protocol_hint_rerank: Use openai_compat for OpenAI-compatible rerank endpoints and dashscope_native for native DashScope rerank endpoints.
connect.pure_search_note: : this source only has a search model and no chat model — saving is still allowed.
connect.blocked_name_format: The connection identifier can contain only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
connect.blocked_address_missing: The endpoint address is still missing.
connect.blocked_api_version_missing: The API version is still missing.
connect.blocked_no_model: Add at least one model ID.
connect.blocked_duplicate_ids: Two models share an ID — make them unique.
connect.blocked_capability_missing: Every model needs at least one capability selected.
connect.blocked_outbound_value_missing: An outbound parameter set to “Fix at…” or “At most…” still needs a value.
connect.blocked_runtime_parameters_invalid: A request parameter needs attention. Check its type, JSON value or incompatible reasoning rules.
connect.blocked_credit_rates_invalid: Check the three credit multipliers for each model.
connect.blocked_overrides_invalid: The raw request parameters are not a valid JSON object.
connect.blocked_test_required: Test the connection first — saving needs a passing test.
connect.base_url_scope_local: A public domain, an on-prem address or a bare IP all work; http is supported too.
connect.base_url_scope_saas: This deployment accepts public https addresses only; on-prem addresses need your operator to change the deployment mode.
connect.context_window_hint_unknown: Keep the default if you're unsure; change it to the exact value from the provider's documentation if you know it.

verify.unauthorized: Invalid key. Check the key and enter it again.
verify.deployment_not_found: Deployment/model not found, or the Endpoint is not the root address
verify.rate_limited: The model service is rate limited
verify.probe_not_supported: This capability cannot be verified for the selected protocol
verify.invalid_response: The model service returned an invalid response
verify.tool_call_missing: The model did not return the required tool call
verify.embedding_missing: The response did not contain a numeric embedding
verify.connection_only: Connection verified; model capabilities were not tested
verify.capability_degraded: Connection works; {degraded}/{total} capabilities require non-streaming compatibility mode
verify.capability_complete: Connection verified; all {total} model capabilities verified

default.title: Default model
default.sub: Which model the whole product uses, plus fallbacks.
default.empty_body: The default model must support tool calling. Connect a model with the Tools capability in ① first.
default.label: Default model
default.fallback_note: tried in order when the primary is unavailable
default.fallback_empty: None — no downgrade if the primary fails.
default.note: One model runs everything. Per-stage model selection isn't offered for now.

tier.title: Model assignment
tier.sub: Just set a main model · expand advanced only to save cost/time
tier.desc: Assign models by workload strength. By default one main model runs everything; the other tiers follow it.
tier.empty_body: First connect a chat model (with the “tool” capability) under “① Your model sources” to set a main model.
tier.primary_effect_suffix: used for chat, data analysis, reports, planning
tier.adv_label: Advanced: set separate models for light tasks and evaluation (optional)
tier.adv_summary_follow: Light follows the main model · Evaluation auto-picked {judge}
tier.fast_desc1: High-frequency small tasks: intent, titles, term matching, memory tidying.
tier.fast_desc2: A cheap, fast one saves real money and time.
tier.judge_desc1: Scoring, verification, debate merging. Agent evaluation uses it too.
tier.judge_desc2: Only meaningful if different from the main model — otherwise it grades its own paper.
tier.judge_auto_none: There is no other chat model, so evaluation uses the main model {model} and grades its own answers. Add another chat model to a connection (one from the same provider works), and Auto switches to it.
tier.judge_auto_no_primary: Choose the main model first; Auto then picks the evaluation model.
tier.judge_same_warn: Same as the main model — evaluation loses its meaning
tier.adv_summary_follow_pending: Light follows the main model · Evaluation is picked automatically
tier.adv_summary_follow_same: Light follows the main model · Evaluation can only use the main model {model}

kb.title: Knowledge base models
kb.desc: Separate from chat: vector / rerank are chosen independently. Changing the vector model rebuilds the whole knowledge-base index.
kb.empty_body: Give a model the Vector capability in ①, or connect an embedding source, and it'll show up here.
kb.required_guard_body: Pick a model with the Vector capability so the knowledge base can build its index and retrieve.
kb.retrieval_hint: Default {count} chunks; queries may request up to {max}. More results use more context.
kb.rebuild_title: Change vector model = rebuild the whole KB index
kb.rebuild_body: Switching to {model} re-embeds every document with the new model. Retrieval may be incomplete during the rebuild; the old index keeps serving until the new one is ready.
kb.dim_hint: Embedding vector dimension for this model (must match the model).

del.title: Delete source “{name}”?
del.clean_body: This source and its models will be removed from the catalog.
del.soft_body: {count} assignment(s) reference it — deleting will clear those references first.
del.hard_title: Can't delete — the knowledge-base vector is using it
del.hard_body: Reassign the vector model in ③ first, then this source can be deleted.

media.title: Image generation
media.sub: The model used to generate images in reports / canvas
media.desc: Separate from chat and the knowledge base: image generation uses a dedicated text-to-image model, picked on its own.
media.empty_body: Add an image source under “① Your model sources”, toggle its model's “Image gen” capability, and pick a call protocol.
media.effect: Used when generating images in reports / canvas.

search.title: Web search
search.sub: The model used to search the web for external / real-time info in reports / analysis
search.desc: Separate from chat and the knowledge base: web search uses a dedicated search model, picked on its own. No config = the team has no web_search tool.
search.empty_body: Add a search source under “① Your model sources”, toggle its model's “Web search” capability, and pick a call protocol.
search.effect: Used to search the web when external / real-time info is needed.

runtime.profile_mismatch: This profile does not match the current provider or API surface. Choose a compatible profile; your parameters have been retained.
runtime.retained_reasoning: Reasoning settings were retained without a matching profile. Select their profile or explicitly remove these settings before saving.
runtime.title: Request parameters
runtime.summary_off: Thinking off · {count, plural, one {# override} other {# overrides}}
runtime.unknown_help: Reasoning support is not declared. Select a compatible profile, or use Advanced where this adapter supports it.
runtime.profile_contract: Select only a documented contract supported by your model. This choice is not evidence that the upstream service accepts it.
runtime.coverage: Shared defaults apply to {capabilities}. Parallel tool calls apply only to Tool requests.
runtime.scope_inherit: Override only the fields needed for {capability}. Other fields continue using model defaults.
runtime.independent: {capabilities} has an independent thinking policy that will remain unchanged.
runtime.undeclared: No longer declared; remove its overrides before saving
runtime.thinking_help: Controls model reasoning, not trace visibility or a guarantee of zero reasoning cost.
runtime.budget_help: {min}–{max} integer tokens. Manual thinking must be enabled. Anthropic requires room for the final output and temperature 1 or omission.
runtime.incompatible_rules: Off or provider omission conflicts with explicit effort or budget. Remove those rules or change the mode.
runtime.remove_review: Remove the effort and token-budget overrides in this scope? Thinking mode and generation rules will remain unchanged.
runtime.baseline_help: Inheritance preserves existing provider, legacy model and caller settings. It is not the same as asking the provider to decide. Inspect a capability preview for the final value and source.
runtime.advanced_help: Use exact top-level wire field names and static JSON values. Do not use dotted keys, runtime fields, credentials or templates.
runtime.advanced_json: Advanced parameter JSON for this scope
runtime.advanced_invalid: Use unique exact field names and valid JSON values. Fix the current view before switching or saving.
runtime.unverified: Provider acceptance unverified. Opening this editor or preview sends no paid model request.
runtime.advanced_unavailable: This adapter does not consume arbitrary advanced JSON. Use the supported profile controls.
runtime.legacy_help: Existing per-capability JSON and outbound rules keep their scope and precedence until you explicitly convert them. Unrelated edits do not require conversion.
runtime.conversion_scope: The following recognized fields move to typed capability overrides. Only their original capability is affected; existing typed values retain precedence. Unrecognized fields remain in JSON.
runtime.preview_help: Synthetic input; no provider calls or configuration writes. Caller-dependent values are representative, not universal defaults.
runtime.preview_failed: Could not compile this preview. Check the connection and parameter fields, or reload the saved baseline if another administrator changed it.
runtime.outdated: Preview outdated. Refresh it for the current draft and capability.

outbound.title: Request parameters
outbound.subtitle: What we send to this model with every request
outbound.param_temperature_hint: Higher is more varied. Some models only accept their own default
outbound.param_top_p_hint: Same family as randomness; usually leave alone
outbound.param_max_tokens_hint: Some gateways cap this and reject the whole request if exceeded
outbound.param_parallel_tool_calls_hint: Lets the model call several tools at once. Some services refuse
outbound.adapted_text: The model service rejected "{param}", so we stopped sending it.
outbound.adapted_dispute_body: This came from the model service, not from us. Set the parameter explicitly above and we'll stop adjusting it.
outbound.raw_hint: Service-specific fields beyond the four above go here.
outbound.raw_conflict: "{key}" is already set above; the setting above wins.
outbound.anthropic_max_tokens_required: This protocol requires a limit; it can't be omitted.

retry.title: Model behavior
retry.label: Automatic retries on failure
retry.hint: When a model call fails before replying (timeout, connection failure, or a temporary service error), Bowhead retries it up to this many times within the turn's time limit. Default {default}; allowed range {min}–{max}. Set 0 to turn retries off.
retry.saved: Retry setting saved. It applies to new model calls.
retry.error_range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
retry.error_stale: The model configuration changed after this page loaded. Reload the page, then set the retry count again.
retry.error_not_configured: This team has no saved model configuration yet. Add a connection and save the model configuration first, then change retries.

output_budget.unavailable: Defaults could not be loaded. Reopen this page to see the automatic allowance.
output_budget.invalid: Enter a positive whole number of tokens.
output_budget.hint: Capacity describes the model. Request parameters below control each call. Automatic allowances shrink to fit the input; this is a maximum, not expected usage.

models.configuration_proposal_unsaved: Save or discard your current edits before loading this suggestion.
models.configuration_proposal_stale: This suggestion uses an earlier model configuration. Ask the Configuration Agent to read the settings and prepare a new suggestion.
models.configuration_proposal_unavailable: This suggestion could not be loaded. It may have been applied, dismissed, or become unavailable; check your Team permissions and ask for a new suggestion.

context_policy.on_hint: Organize older context when more room is needed.
context_policy.off_hint: When space runs out, omit older context from this request. Saved history stays intact.
context_policy.limits_hint: Automatic values adapt to the model and request. Required evidence stays intact.
context_policy.invalid: Enter positive whole token counts. Keep recent tokens must be lower than the trigger.

bowra.imported: Bowra configuration imported; it is not effective yet. Review the Chat and Tool capability declarations, select a primary model if needed, then review and apply. Model names alone do not prove capability support. Leaving or discarding this draft does not revoke the key in Bowra.
bowra.invalid_callback: This Bowra connection attempt is invalid, expired or already processed. Start a new connection. If you already approved access, first check the new key in Bowra API Keys.
bowra.unavailable: Bowra service configuration changed. Ask your administrator to check BOWRA_URL before starting another connection.
bowra.permission_changed: Your session or model configuration permissions changed. Sign in to the original team as an owner or administrator, then start again after checking the key in Bowra API Keys.
bowra.cancelled: Bowra authorization was cancelled. Existing model connections have not changed.
bowra.rate_limited: Bowra limited the exchange request. Check the newly created key in Bowra API Keys before deciding whether to reconnect.
bowra.service_unavailable: Bowra could not deliver the configuration. Check the newly created key in Bowra API Keys before deciding whether to reconnect.
bowra.exchange_rejected: Bowra rejected the authorization code. Check the key created for this attempt in Bowra API Keys before reconnecting.
bowra.exchange_uncertain: The Bowra configuration could not be received or validated. In Bowra API Keys, check the key for this application by name and creation time. Disable or delete that individual key if needed before reconnecting.
bowra.no_models: Bowra returned no available models; no connection was imported. Check model availability in Bowra. Authorization already created a key; manage it in Bowra API Keys without repeatedly authorizing.
bowra.import_expired: The Bowra import expired, was already claimed, or could not be received. Check the key for this attempt in Bowra API Keys before reconnecting.
bowra.https_required: Bowra requires a callback on an HTTPS website domain using port 443. Open this application through such an address before connecting; HTTP, localhost and IP addresses cannot receive this callback.
bowra.encryption_required: Bowra import requires credential encryption. Ask your administrator to configure a valid BOWHEAD_FERNET_KEY before connecting.
bowra.service_url_invalid: The Bowra authorization service address is invalid or blocked by deployment policy. Ask your administrator to correct BOWRA_URL.
bowra.start_failed: Bowra authorization could not start. Check your session and team permissions, or ask your administrator to check BOWRA_URL and service availability.

subagents.title: Agents
subagents.subtitle: Manage the Agents included with the product. Enable them for your team or tailor their settings.
subagents.disabled_notice: The subagents feature isn't enabled for your team. Contact an admin to turn it on.
subagents.live_save_notice: Changes here apply only to this team's system-provided built-in agents and affect subsequent team tasks immediately.
subagents.empty_body: Click "New subagent" in the top right to assemble your team's existing tools into a dedicated subagent that routing can call by name, or just tell me in chat "build me a subagent that does X".
subagents.builtin_empty_body: This version does not provide any system built-in agents. Created and marketplace agents remain available in Agent management.
subagents.audience_description: Choose only you, selected members and groups, or the whole team. Selected access is saved as one exact replacement, with no hidden grants left behind.
subagents.audience_atomic_note: Saving atomically replaces the complete allow list; security-policy denies are unchanged.
subagents.audience_private_title: Only the Owner can use this subagent
subagents.audience_private_body: Saving revokes the current {count} member / group grants. Switching back to selected access later will not restore the old list.
subagents.audience_team_title: Every active team member can use this subagent
subagents.audience_team_body: Saving clears the current {count} selected grants and writes one team-wide grant, with no hidden roster.
subagents.audience_directory_failed: Team members and groups could not be loaded. Try again later.
subagents.audience_custom_empty: Select at least one member or group before saving.
subagents.audience_release_managed: This Agent is managed through the release workflow. Change visibility in the configuration workspace, then publish it.
subagents.delete_description: Delete "{label}" ({name})? This cannot be undone, and routing will no longer call it.
subagents.intent_recommended: Recommended · Bowhead will prefill a draft from your available capabilities
subagents.intent_body: Describe what it should work on, what it should do, and the result you expect. You do not need to know any tool names.
subagents.intent_placeholder: For example: analyze store sales every week, find unusual declines, and create a trend chart for operations to review.
subagents.intent_example_analysis: Analyze weekly sales anomalies and create a trend chart
subagents.intent_example_research: Research recent competitor activity and organize the sources
subagents.intent_example_operations: Read customer status and produce a follow-up list
subagents.intent_canvas_tip: This task already has a saved draft. You can stop waiting and fill it in manually; return to the same draft for suggestions later.
subagents.intent_canvas_conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Its latest version is loaded; review your goal and generate again.
subagents.create_chat_unbound: This creation form is not connected to the chat on the left. Describe and edit it here; chat replies will not update it automatically.
subagents.draft_chat_unbound: Review this draft here. The chat on the left will not edit it; save and check any changes you make on the right.
subagents.draft_chat_bound: This chat is connected to the draft. Describe a change on the left; the right panel updates after it is saved. Review before creating.
subagents.draft_chat_save_first: There are unsaved changes on the right. Save or discard them before sending a chat message; your input is kept.
subagents.draft_chat_protocol_unavailable: This conversation cannot edit the selected Agent draft yet. Your message is kept. Edit the draft on the right, or close it to send a regular message.
subagents.intent_insufficient: Please be more specific: add what it should work on, what it should do, or the result you expect.
subagents.intent_timeout: AI drafting didn’t finish within two and a half minutes and was stopped. Your description is kept: try again, or if it keeps timing out, ask a team owner or administrator to choose a faster main model in Team settings › Models. You can also fill it in yourself.
subagents.intent_model_unconfigured: The team model is not configured. Contact a team administrator; you can still configure this Agent manually.
subagents.intent_credits_exhausted: There is not enough available credit to generate a draft. Your goal is preserved, and you can configure it manually.
subagents.intent_invalid_result: The generated result did not pass validation, so no draft was created. Your goal is preserved; retry or configure it manually.
subagents.intent_sensitive_result: The generated result appeared to contain a credential, so drafting stopped. Your goal is preserved; retry or configure it manually.
subagents.intent_unavailable: Draft generation is temporarily unavailable. Your goal is preserved; retry or configure it manually.
subagents.draft_review_title: Agent draft generated from your description
subagents.draft_clarify_hint: We ask at most one business question. You can edit all other fields in the draft.
subagents.draft_clarify_placeholder: For example: use team BI data, read only, and do not update external systems.
subagents.draft_blocked_title: This draft cannot be created yet
subagents.draft_blocked_body: The additional detail still did not produce a complete, safe configuration. You can switch to manual configuration.
subagents.draft_generation_failed: Generation did not finish, and the draft has been updated. Your goal and answer are still available for manual setup.
subagents.draft_expired_body: The draft configuration was cleared according to the retention policy. Describe the goal again or configure it manually.
subagents.draft_tools_text_only: This draft works only with text you provide and needs no tools or skills. Confirm the scope below before creating it.
subagents.draft_tools_empty: No available tool was resolved for this goal. Add one from the tool catalog or revise the goal and generate a new draft.
subagents.draft_tool_catalog_open: Add or replace tools from catalog
subagents.draft_tool_catalog_error: The tool catalog is unavailable. Your selected tools and draft are still here. Try again.
subagents.draft_tool_catalog_narrow: Too many results. Search for a more specific tool name or purpose.
subagents.draft_tool_catalog_unavailable: A selected tool is no longer available. Remove it or contact an administrator.
subagents.draft_validation_tool_required: This team requires at least one tool. Add one from the tool catalog.
subagents.draft_validation_tool_unavailable: “{name}” cannot be used for creation now. Remove or replace it, then save again.
subagents.draft_validation_unknown: Configuration checks failed. Review the fields and resources, then save again.
subagents.draft_locked_mcp: MCP is not licensed for this account
subagents.draft_locked_precise_skill_scope: Cannot limit access to specific skills; choose the skills instead
subagents.draft_locked_approval_executor: This deployment cannot execute this tool's approval workflow. It cannot be added now; existing selections can be removed.
subagents.draft_private_note: Only you can use it; you can share it from its detail page after creation.
subagents.draft_validation_valid: Configuration checks passed. Ready to create.
subagents.draft_validation_warning: This configuration can be created after you confirm the notes below.
subagents.draft_validation_invalid: Configuration checks failed. Fix the marked issues.

skill_coach.degraded_coach_rerouted: It concluded the fix does not belong in this body — the problem may be a missing file, a tool to connect, or a deployment switch.
skill_coach.degraded_unknown: The coach could not finish. Try again later, or edit it by hand.
skill_coach.stale: This skill's body changed after the coach drafted. This draft was written against the old content and applying it would overwrite those edits — ask the coach again.

collab_errors.waiting: This agent can't finish yet: a question it asked another agent is still waiting for an answer. It continues automatically once the question is answered or closed, so usually no action is needed. If it stays stuck, stop the turn and send the request again.
collab_errors.format: This message between agents was not in a form the system accepts, so it had no effect. The agent corrects it and continues. If this step keeps failing, send the request again.
collab_errors.closed: This message referred to a question that was already answered, closed or expired, so it had no effect. The agent continues with what it already has.
collab_errors.limit: The agents reached this turn's messaging limit (number of messages, length or time), so no more messages are sent. They continue with what they have. For a complete result, split the task into smaller requests.
collab_errors.forbidden: This message involved an action or material this agent is not allowed to use, so it was not sent. If that material is needed, make sure you have access to it, or ask an administrator to grant access, then try again.
collab_errors.unavailable: The agent this message was for has already finished or is unavailable, so it was not delivered. The other agents continue. If the result is missing that part, send the request again.

deck_errors.not_admitted: No presentation was created: this step was not authorized to create a new deck. Ask again for a new presentation. To change an uploaded deck, use its document revision flow instead.

deck_errors.invalid: The generated slides did not pass checks (for example, the slide count did not match or the content structure was incomplete). The agent corrects and retries. If it keeps failing, simplify the request, for example by stating the slide count and the points for each slide.
deck_errors.missing: This step produced no downloadable presentation, so there is nothing to download. Check the failed steps above, then send the request again or upload a PPT template and retry.

sample.description: Reconcile each channel's gross margin and its basis, locate anomalies, and give traceable attributions.
sample.trigger_suffix: channel margin / basis check / margin anomaly
triggers: Check the gross margin for each channel
Are there any channel margin anomalies?
Help me reconcile the margin basis
steps: Use bi_query to pull sales, cost, and rebate data for each channel within {{time_window}}
In python_sandbox, compute gross margin by {{group_by}} and align it with the finance basis (tax-inclusive / tax-exclusive)
Flag channels whose gross margin deviates ±3pct from baseline, and trace order details to locate the source
Use canvas to produce a channel margin comparison chart + anomaly list, with attributions and next-step suggestions
checkpoints: Every channel's gross margin is labeled with its basis (tax-inclusive / tax-exclusive)
Every anomalous channel has at least one traceable piece of order-level evidence
The final conclusion separates “data basis issues” from “real business fluctuations”
script_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(gmv) gmv, SUM(cost) cost, SUM(rebate) rebate
script_py: # … basis alignment and anomaly flags are implemented on intent at runtime
sample.final_answer_preview: East China KA gross margin in May was 18.2%, −2.1pct MoM, mainly due to a rebate policy change; the online channel's tax-inclusive basis was misaligned — after correction its margin is back to 21.4%. 3 channels triggered the ±3pct anomaly, each with order-level evidence…
sample.orchestrator_prompt: You orchestrate the channel margin reconciliation. Pull data first, then check the basis, flag anomalies, and chart last. Self-check strictly against the checkpoints; draw no conclusion without evidence.

pass: All 4 channels' margins are labeled with the tax-inclusive basis
Each anomalous channel cites its order numbers
The conclusion clearly separates basis corrections from real fluctuations
fail: All channel margins carry a basis
The online channel anomaly lacks order-level evidence; only totals were given
Basis issues and business fluctuations weren't separated; the attribution is vague
partial: All anomalous channels have order evidence
The distinction isn't clear enough; consider adding a sentence on the basis

turn_card.chat_body: “Gross margin” here uses the tax-exclusive basis: (sales − cost − rebates) / sales. The online channel had tax-inclusive amounts mixed in, which is why it ran high — want me to run this round as well?
turn_card.chat_note: Chat-only turn · no analysis workflow to solidify → no chip
turn_card.running_note: Turn in progress · not finished → no chip (it appears once done)
turn_card.error_body: bi_query timed out fetching data; this turn produced no result.
turn_card.error_note: Failed turn → no chip (no successful workflow to reuse)
turn_card.done_body: Checked May gross margin for each channel. The online channel's tax-inclusive basis was misaligned; after correction its margin went from 26.8% back to 21.4%. East China KA's MoM decline is mainly due to a rebate policy change, with order-level evidence attached.
